summary: NAINA OS Volume 10 — Governance, Security & Digital Constitution (GSDC v1.0). Covers Document 10.1 (The Constitution), Document 10.2 (Zero Trust Security Framework), Document 10.3 (Capability Tokens), Document 10.4 (Threat Model), Document 10.5 (Trust Engine), Document 10.6 (Memory Privacy), Document 10.7 (Audit Framework), Document 10.8 (Safety Engine), Document 10.9 (Policy Engine), Document 10.10 (Governance Framework & TSC), the NAINA RFC System, and the Ecosystem Synthesis.
